mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invoice_wallet(tenant_id,owner_id) SELECT #{tenant},#{owner} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoice_wallet WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND owner_id=#{ownerId})
mapper.update: UPDATE invoice_wallet SET used_bytes=used_bytes+#{bytes},upload_count=upload_count+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND owner_id=#{owner} AND used_bytes<=#{usedBytes} AND upload_count<#{maximumUploads}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM invoice_original WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND invoice_id=#{invoiceId}
SELECT * FROM invoice_original WHERE tenant_id=#{parameters.tenant} AND invoice_id IN (#{item})
SELECT * FROM invoice_original WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND invoice_id=#{invoiceId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE invoice_original SET status=#{status} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND invoice_id=#{invoiceId} AND status<>'READY'
mapper.select: SELECT o.*,r.state_json,r.version AS resource_version FROM invoice_original o JOIN finance_resource r ON r.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND r.resource_type=o.resource_type AND r.id=o.invoice_id WHERE o.tenant_id=#{argument1} AND o.owner_id=#{argument2} AND o.invoice_id<#{argument3} ORDER BY o.invoice_id DESC LIMIT #{argument4}
